title: 2.5 Viruses
description: Viral structure, replication cycles, host dependence and virus-related concepts. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Virus?
options: The time between infection and the appearance of symptoms
A viral cycle that ends with destruction of the host cell
A surface protein that helps a virus attach to host cells
A non-cellular infectious agent that requires a host cell
questions.correctAnswer: A non-cellular infectious agent that requires a host cell

questions.question: What is Capsid?
options: A viral cycle in which viral DNA integrates into the host genome
A non-cellular infectious agent that requires a host cell
A living cell that a virus infects and uses for replication
The protein coat that surrounds the genetic material of a virus
questions.correctAnswer: The protein coat that surrounds the genetic material of a virus

questions.question: What is Envelope?
options: A state in which a virus remains dormant in the host
An infectious misfolded protein that can cause disease
A small infectious RNA molecule without a protein coat
A lipid layer surrounding the capsid of some viruses
questions.correctAnswer: A lipid layer surrounding the capsid of some viruses

questions.question: What is Nucleic acid?
options: An enzyme that makes DNA from an RNA template
A virus that specifically infects bacterial cells
The DNA or RNA that makes up the viral genome
A modified virus used to deliver genes into cells
questions.correctAnswer: The DNA or RNA that makes up the viral genome

questions.question: What is Virion?
options: The process by which a virus makes copies of itself
A medicine that inhibits the replication of viruses
A complete infectious virus particle outside a cell
A lipid layer surrounding the capsid of some viruses
questions.correctAnswer: A complete infectious virus particle outside a cell
